answer: On a caption market, a job may explain basalt or retell a fable. A buyer must escrow payment plus a nonrefundable review fee under a unique job ID. Two randomly selected established reviewers grade the seller output before reputation rises, and each job ID and output hash can earn only once. An attacker can forge many account names, but self-dealing burns a fee for every fake job and still needs acceptable work under independent review; copying one caption across identities earns nothing.
